Title: Verify the Dynamic Button toggles between START and STOP
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Read the button text (START) 2. Click the button 3. Verify it shows STOP 4. Click again 5. Verify it shows START
Expected Result: Button text alternates START -> STOP -> START

Title: Verify an item can be chosen from the Scrolling DropDown
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Click the Scrolling DropDown field 2. Scroll the list to 'Item 25' 3. Click 'Item 25' 4. Read the field value
Expected Result: Field shows 'Item 25' and the list closes

Title: Verify lazy-loaded items appear while scrolling the Scrolling DropDown
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Data: Item: Item 150 (not in the first 100 loaded items)
Steps: 1. Click the Scrolling DropDown field 2. Scroll to the bottom repeatedly until 'Item 150' is loaded 3. Click 'Item 150' 4. Read the field value
Expected Result: More items load on scroll; field shows 'Item 150'

Title: Verify SVG shapes are present on the page
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Scroll to 'SVG Elements' 2. Count the SVG graphics 3. Read the shape types
Expected Result: At least 3 SVG graphics exist including a circle and a rectangle

Title: Verify elements inside the Shadow DOM can be read and operated
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Open the shadow root of the shadow host 2. Read the info text 3. Type text in the shadow text box 4. Tick the shadow checkbox 5. Read the shadow link
Expected Result: Info text is 'Mobiles'; typed text is retained; checkbox is ticked; link points to pavantestingtools.com

Title: Verify the Wikipedia search widget returns results
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open; internet access to Wikipedia is available
Steps: 1. Scroll to the 'Tabs' (Wikipedia) widget 2. Type a search term 3. Click the search button 4. Wait for the results 5. Count the result links
Expected Result: At least one search result is displayed
